sources.author: John Phamous
sources.use: Method basis: judgment prose plus a bounded style vocabulary, named anti-patterns, correction placement by the narrowest enforceable surface, and a frozen-scenario comparison loop. Independently written; no upstream text copied.

sources.title: Building a beautiful iOS app with 3 Claude Fable prompts
sources.author: Anshu
sources.use: Method basis: intent framing with an explicit quality bar, the two-pass build that reopens constraints for a dedicated aesthetics pass, and self-verification of rendered output through successive frames and pixel comparison. Independently written; no upstream text copied.

changes: Kept platform-neutral: no simulator, recording, frame-dump, or pixel-diff tool is assumed to exist unless the Host provides it.
Replaced the source-specific workflows with reader/task intent, observable decisions, and named anti-patterns as the portable core.
Added the `inspected` evidence state so that looking at the rendered result stays distinct from acceptance and delivery.
Bound corrections to reusable primitives and the narrowest enforceable placement instead of output hand-tuning.
Kept the method independent of Trio governance; selection references live in the dev and office capability surfaces.
updates: Manual review of the linked sources; no automatic upstream replacement. No measurable benefit claim is made until paired evidence exists.
